claims.claim: banned_words aliases content_excludes; match_mode defaults to word_boundary under that name only
sentence_count takes an optional positive max (max_sentences normalizes to it); a reply within it scores 1 and a longer one max / count; a guardrail blocks and does not truncate
cosine_similarity takes a reference float array, reads the target embedding from Metadata[embedding], scores the raw similarity and rejects min_similarity, min_score and max_score
regex has expect_match param (default true)
json_path uses JMESPath; expression (alias jmespath_expression), expected, contains, min, max, min_results, max_results, allow_wrapped, extract_json
tools_called params: tool_names/tools, min_calls default 1, max_calls default unbounded, ignore_validation, require_args
tools_offered is registered and reads EvalContext.ToolsOffered with absent/exact params
tool_call_chain param is steps (array of step objects), not chain string[]
tool_result_includes/matches/has_media/media_type use param tool (not tool_name); tool_result_media_type uses mime_type; includes/matches have occurrence default 1
tool_calls_with_args params: tool_name, expected_args, args_match, result_includes, result_matches, no_error
no_tool_errors takes optional tools filter; tool_no_repeat max_repeats default 1
legacy param words normalizes to patterns for content_excludes and banned_words
agent_invoked / agent_not_invoked param is agents (not agent_names); agent_response_contains uses agent and contains (not agent_name/patterns)
skill checks read skill__activate calls (name arg); skill_activated min_calls default 1
spoke_in_state passes only with non-empty assistant text stamped with the state; whitespace excluded; missing stamps explained
composition handlers read Metadata keys; equals takes precedence over contains; reject min_score/max_score
image_dimensions also takes exact width/height; video_resolution also min_height/max_height; presets map to heights
classifier common params: model, expected_label required; default role user for audio_emotion, assistant otherwise; message_index default -1; classifier_id rejected
no provider named and none default -> skipped (passes); named provider unresolved -> error
topic_policy params, defaults and closed key set
topic_policy on_deny: block answers with the message, respond answers with the policy response, and a validator message still wins
topic_policy: media-only turn resolves through on_unknown; recent_turns filters tool, safety and interrupted turns
an eval never states pass/fail; only assertion and guardrail wrappers set Passed
topic_policy backends: nvidia-topic-control requires base_url, default timeout 20s, model default; timeout_seconds conflicts with request_timeout; systemone needs credential unless loopback
topic_policy is English-only / MVP direction input only; deferred direction both
topic_policy: OPENAI_API_KEY used only for OpenAI's endpoint
llm_judge accepts params criteria, rubric, system_prompt, provider and extra; model is rejected with an error result
judge-backed guardrail with no provider param and no default judge fails Open()
RAG context forms: contexts, context, context_field in that order; contextual_recall needs reference or expected_output
pii_leakage regex pre-pass (email, ssn, 16-digit card), degrades to score 1 with no judge
role_violation uses agent_role then Metadata system_prompt
params failing validation are a warning and skip; unknown type fatal
unrecognized direction falls back to output with a warning
assertion wrapper: default min_score 1.0, error fails, nil score passes
rest_eval: method default POST, timeout default 30s, include_messages default true, include_tool_calls default false, extra forwarded; min_score is not read
a2a_eval timeout default 60s; auth_token supports env expansion; min_score and max_score are rejected
latency_budget reads Metadata latency_ms; cost_budget reads total_cost/input_tokens/output_tokens and has max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens; cost_budget fires on on_session_complete
guardrail_triggered param is validator_type (alias validator); should_trigger default true; triggered = score < 1.0; direction filter
directional rejects threshold with an error result; similar_content scores the word-overlap ratio and the assertion wrapper owns the pass line
exec eval env lists host variable names to pass through (not NAME=value); timeout_ms default 30s
tool_exec params, defaults and score extraction rules
Arena injects tool_registry automatically / CompositionMetadataProvider injects composition metadata
content_excludes and max_length implement StreamableEvalHandler; stream matching is substring and honors case_sensitive
min_length/max_length: required positive; legacy min_characters/min_chars, max_characters/max_chars; max_tokens = bytes/4
guardrail triggers when score < min_score (default 1.0) or > max_score; nil result or score triggers
threshold params are rejected by eval handlers with an error result; tool_exec and topic_policy reject at load

Every built-in handler lists its params (ParamNamer); an unknown param is rejected at load by ValidateEvalTypes, guardrail construction and inside wrapper eval_params; min_score and max_score are never unknown; guardrails also accept direction and message; exec evals are never checked; the error names the valid params

llm_judge, llm_judge_session and llm_judge_tool_calls with no system_prompt render the prompt named by Metadata judge_defaults.prompt from Metadata prompt_registry with criteria, rubric, response and conversation; a missing or unrenderable prompt is an error result

A pack eval of type assertion or guardrail can declare threshold {operator, value} (gte, gt, lte, lt, eq; gt and lt strict); declaring it with min_score or max_score is an error; ValidateEvalTypes reports an unusable threshold; on other evals it is carried, not applied
A handler may implement GroupDeclarer to declare classification groups; aliases are classified as their target; RegisterTypeGroups takes precedence
any registered handler incl. aliases can serve as a guardrail
alias table: 13 aliases
session tool types are tools_called_session, tools_not_called_session, tool_args_session (not 'tools_called (session)'); tool_called aliases the turn-level tools_called
workflow types registered as state_is and transitioned_to, not workflow_state_is / workflow_transitioned_to
param aliases and defaults are keyed by the declared check name; guardrail factory and eval validation apply ApplyDefaults, NormalizeParams and the unknown-param check on the declared type name
